instruction: Fold the towel diagonally so that one corner lies on the opposite corner, then let go.

outcome.real_measurement: top-down camera: detect the two marked corners, metric distance via table-plane homography
top-down camera: towel segmentation area / area before the episode
side/depth camera: towel pixels higher than 5 cm above the table

counterexamples.name: drag_on_ground
counterexamples.description: drags corner A to C without lifting

counterexamples.name: expert
counterexamples.description: positive control: lift, carry over C, lower, release

notes: v2 thresholds; v1 (5 cm, all vertices < 5 cm) rejected the expert in ~60% of parallel worlds (see research/results/towel_*_w64_full.json). Cross-engine expert dAC: 1.8 / 7.05 / 7.2 cm.
